name: shared-item-alert-lure
description: A bank-alert lure delivered by a genuine file-sharing service: the attacker shared a document from a free account, so the notice is the service's own, authenticated and linked to the service. The only part the attacker wrote is the file's name, which is worded as a security alert.

email.subject: Item shared with you: "Online ID Locked Due to Unrecognized Log-In - Verify Immediately.pdf"
